purpose.en: Build the glutes and strengthen hip extension.

text.zh: 夹紧臀部把腿向后抬，腰不后仰
text.en: Squeeze your glute to sweep the leg back without arching your back

text.zh: 双手扶椅背，上身微微前倾
text.en: Hold the chair back with both hands and lean slightly forward.

text.zh: 骨盆保持朝前，慢慢放回
text.en: Keep your pelvis square and return slowly.

commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back instead of extending the hip.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 使用稳固、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
